item.title: Madonna and Sabrina Carpenter, Kacey Musgraves, Zara Larsson & More: New Music Friday Guide
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Billboard's Friday Music Guide, your weekly rundown of the most essential releases in music. I'm your host, and I'm excited to share the hottest new tracks and albums that everyone will be talking about today and dominating playlists all weekend long."
[Upbeat music transitions]
Host: "First up, a massive collaboration between Madonna and Sabrina Carpenter, 'Bring Your Love'. This alluring dance-pop track was previewed at Coachella, and it's officially out now. Get ready to kick off summer with this sonic bait that's sure to lure you onto the dance floor. And, Madonna fans, don't forget her upcoming album 'Confessions II' drops on July 3."
[Music transitions to Kacey Musgraves]
Host: "Next, Kacey Musgraves releases her highly anticipated album 'Middle of Nowhere'. With tracks like 'Horses and Divorces', featuring country icon Miranda Lambert, this album is a must-listen. Musgraves draws inspiration from the Mexican community, and it's evident across the entire record."
[Music transitions to Sienna Spiro]
Host: "The 'Devil Wears Prada 2' soundtrack is out now, featuring an original song from Sienna Spiro, 'Material Lover'. Produced by Omer Fedi, this track showcases Spiro's signature warmth and puts her in the company of superstars like Lady Gaga and Doechii."
[Music transitions to Zara Larsson]
Host: "Zara Larsson's collaborations album 'Girls Trip' has arrived, featuring 10 fresh takes on her original tracks from 'Midnight Sun'. With guests like PinkPantheress, Shakira, and Robyn, this girl-powered edition takes the album to the next level."
[Music transitions to Bella Poarch]
Host: "Last but not least, Bella Poarch releases her new single 'Ribcage'. This alternative pop track opens with a gorgeous string section and features Poarch singing about watching her thoughts 'turn to dust and decompose'."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for this week's Friday Music Guide. Check out these essential releases and more on our website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time with the latest and greatest in music."
